reasoning: On the season so far the 76ers are the stronger team; with home court the 76ers start about 6 points better, in a game of about 224 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Pacers.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Pacers (revenge).
Bottom line: the 76ers win 64 times in 100, by about 5; most games like this end between 198 and 247 total points.
